title: Docker
label: Docker
desc: Package, ship and run applications as containers, from a single image to a Compose stack.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the engine, confirm the client talks to the daemon and run the smoke test image.

snippets.code:
# Client and Compose versions
docker --version
docker compose version

# Engine and plugins on Debian or Ubuntu, from Docker's own repository
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y ca-certificates curl
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
sudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

# Run the client as your own user instead of through sudo
sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
newgrp docker

# Client and daemon versions, storage driver and kernel
docker info

# Pull and run the official smoke test, then delete it
docker run --rm hello-world

# Desktop builds bundle the engine, the CLI and Compose
brew install --cask docker
winget install --id Docker.DockerDesktop -e

# Compose is a plugin, so it is called as a subcommand
docker compose version

# Fedora: the engine is packaged as moby-engine, not docker
sudo dnf install moby-engine
sudo systemctl enable --now docker

# Arch: docker and compose are separate packages
sudo pacman -S docker docker-compose
sudo systemctl enable --now docker

# Alpine: OpenRC instead of systemd, and the CLI is its own package
sudo apk add docker docker-cli docker-compose
sudo rc-update add docker default
sudo service docker start

sections.title: Images
sections.description: Read-only templates: list, pull, inspect, tag and move them between machines.

snippets.code:
# Local images with size and creation date
docker images

# Only the untagged leftovers from old builds
docker images --filter dangling=true

# Download or refresh a tag
docker pull postgres:17
docker pull alpine:3.21

# One field from the image config
docker image inspect postgres:17 --format '{{.Config.ExposedPorts}}'
docker image inspect postgres:17 --format '{{.Config.Env}}'

# Layer by layer history, with the command that created each one
docker history postgres:17

# Tag before sending the image to a registry
docker tag cheatrs-api:1.4.0 ghcr.io/felipe/cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Move an image without a registry
docker save cheatrs-api:1.4.0 -o cheatrs-api-1.4.0.tar
docker load -i cheatrs-api-1.4.0.tar

# Look up public images by name
docker search postgres --limit 5

sections.title: Containers
sections.description: Manage the running instances: inspect, start, stop, copy files and change limits.

snippets.code:
# Running containers, then every container including stopped ones
docker ps
docker ps -a

# Full lifecycle without the shortcut flags of docker run
docker create --name cache redis:7-alpine
docker start cache
docker stop cache
docker restart cache
docker rm cache

# Remove a container that is still running
docker rm -f cache

# CPU, memory and network use, live and as a snapshot
docker stats
docker stats --no-stream cheatrs-api

# Processes inside the container as seen from the host
docker top cheatrs-api

# Copy files in both directions
docker cp cheatrs-api:/app/config.yml ./config.yml
docker cp ./seed.sql cheatrs-db:/tmp/seed.sql

# New limits on a running container, no recreation needed
docker update --cpus 1.5 --memory 512m cheatrs-api

# Freeze every process, then let it continue
docker pause cheatrs-api
docker unpause cheatrs-api

# Rename without touching the filesystem
docker rename cheatrs-api cheatrs-api-old

sections.title: Running Containers
sections.description: docker run flags that matter: ports, environment, mounts, users and resource limits.

snippets.code:
# Detached server, host port 8080 to container port 8080, restarted unless stopped
docker run -d --name cheatrs-api -p 8080:8080 --restart unless-stopped cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Foreground shell, thrown away on exit
docker run --rm -it alpine:3.21 sh

# Keep the image entrypoint but run another command in it
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh postgres:17 -c "pg_isready -h db"

# Environment for the process
docker run -d --name cheatrs-db -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=hunter2 -e POSTGRES_DB=cheatrs postgres:17

# The same thing from a file, one KEY=value per line
docker run -d --name cheatrs-db --env-file ./db.env postgres:17

# Named volume so the data outlives the container
docker run -d --name cheatrs-db -v cheatrs_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:17

# Hard limits and a real init process as PID 1
docker run -d --name worker --cpus 2 --memory 1g --memory-swap 1g --init cheatrs-worker:1.4.0

# Non-root user and a fixed working directory
docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -w /app node:22-alpine node -e "console.log(process.cwd())"

# Project folder mounted into an interactive container
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/app -w /app node:22-alpine sh

sections.title: Exec and Shell
sections.description: Open a shell or run a single command inside a container that is already running.

snippets.code:
# Interactive shell in the running container
docker exec -it cheatrs-api sh
docker exec -it cheatrs-db bash

# One command, no session
docker exec cheatrs-api ls -la /app
docker exec cheatrs-db psql -U postgres -d cheatrs -c "select count(*) from users;"

# Test something and see the command exit status
docker exec cheatrs-api sh -c "grep -q ready /tmp/health && echo ready"

# Another user and another directory for this call only
docker exec -u root cheatrs-api chown -R app:app /app/storage
docker exec -w /app cheatrs-api npm run migrate

# Extra environment variable, not persisted in the container
docker exec -e NODE_ENV=test cheatrs-api node scripts/seed.js

# What is actually running inside
docker exec cheatrs-api ps aux

# Long job in the background, output kept in a file inside the container
docker exec -d cheatrs-api sh -c "node scripts/reindex.js > /tmp/reindex.log 2>&1"

# Follow that output from the host
docker exec -it cheatrs-api tail -f /tmp/reindex.log

sections.title: Logs and Inspect
sections.description: Read stdout and stderr, filter by time and pull single fields out of the JSON state.

snippets.code:
# Follow with timestamps, starting from the last 200 lines
docker logs -f --tail 200 -t cheatrs-api

# A time window instead of everything
docker logs --since 30m cheatrs-api
docker logs --since 2026-11-01T10:00:00 --until 2026-11-01T11:00:00 cheatrs-api

# Whole document, then just the parts you need
docker inspect cheatrs-api
docker inspect cheatrs-api --format '{{.State.Status}}'
docker inspect cheatrs-api --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}'
docker inspect cheatrs-api --format '{{json .Mounts}}'

# Files changed in the container since the image layer
docker diff cheatrs-api

# Custom table for several containers
docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'

# Daemon events, handy during a restart loop
docker events --filter container=cheatrs-api --since 10m

sections.title: Volumes
sections.description: Persist data outside the container lifecycle and back it up with a throwaway container.

snippets.code:
# Named volume, managed by Docker
# The label and driver show up in inspect
docker volume create --label project=cheatrs cheatrs_pgdata
docker volume ls
docker volume inspect cheatrs_pgdata

# Delete one volume, or every unused one
docker volume rm cheatrs_pgdata
docker volume prune -f

# Source code from the host, dependencies in a volume so the host folder stays clean
docker run -d --name web -v "$PWD":/app -v web_node_modules:/app/node_modules -p 3000:3000 node:22-alpine sh -c "cd /app && npm install && npm run dev"

# Read-only config file mounted over the image default
docker run --rm -v "$PWD/nginx.conf":/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro nginx:1.27-alpine nginx -t

# Archive a volume from a small helper container
docker run --rm -v cheatrs_pgdata:/data -v "$PWD":/backup alpine:3.21 tar czf /backup/pgdata.tar.gz -C /data .

# Restore the archive into a fresh volume
docker volume create cheatrs_pgdata_new
docker run --rm -v cheatrs_pgdata_new:/data -v "$PWD":/backup alpine:3.21 tar xzf /backup/pgdata.tar.gz -C /data

sections.title: Networks
sections.description: User-defined bridges give containers DNS names and isolate them from unrelated stacks.

snippets.code:
# List and inspect
docker network ls
docker network inspect cheatrs_net

# Bridge network with a fixed subnet
docker network create --driver bridge --subnet 172.28.0.0/16 cheatrs_net

# Attach and detach a container that is already running
docker network connect cheatrs_net cheatrs-api
docker network disconnect cheatrs_net cheatrs-api

# Database reachable from other containers, published only on localhost
docker run -d --name cheatrs-db --network cheatrs_net -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 postgres:17

# Name resolution inside the network: cheatrs-db resolves to its container IP
docker run --rm --network cheatrs_net alpine:3.21 nslookup cheatrs-db

# Host networking removes the port mapping layer, Linux only
docker run --rm --network host nginx:1.27-alpine

sections.title: Building Images
sections.description: Turn a Dockerfile into a tagged image, with build arguments, targets and multiple platforms.

snippets.code:
# Context is the current folder
docker build -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 .

# Another Dockerfile and another context directory
docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.prod -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 ./app

# Pass a build argument and stop at a named stage
docker build --build-arg NODE_ENV=production --target runtime -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 .

# Build for servers and Apple Silicon at once, pushing the manifest list
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/felipe/cheatrs-api:1.4.0 --push .

# Single platform, loaded into the local engine
docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 --load .

# Ignore the layer cache
docker build --no-cache -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 .

# Plain output, one line per step, with timings
docker build --progress=plain -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 .

# Fetch newer base images while rebuilding
docker build --pull -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 .

sections.title: Dockerfile
sections.description: Multi-stage builds keep compilers out of the final image and leave a small, non-root runtime.

snippets.code:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci

FROM deps AS build
COPY . .
RUN npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev

FROM node:22-alpine AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app
RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app
COPY --from=build --chown=app:app /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build --chown=app:app /app/dist ./dist
USER app
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || exit 1
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]

# Pin the base, install system packages in one layer and clean up in the same step
FROM python:3.12-slim
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WORKDIR /srv
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && useradd --create-home app
COPY --chown=app:app . .
USER app
CMD ["python", "-m", "app"]

# Keep the build context small and the COPY layer cache stable
cat > .dockerignore <<'EOF'
.git
node_modules
dist
.env
*.log
EOF

sections.title: Compose
sections.description: Describe a multi-container stack in one YAML file and drive it with docker compose.

snippets.code:
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      target: runtime
    image: cheatrs-api:1.4.0
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://cheatrs:hunter2@db:5432/cheatrs
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  db:
    image: postgres:17
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: cheatrs
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: hunter2
      POSTGRES_DB: cheatrs
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U cheatrs -d cheatrs"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

volumes:
  pgdata:

# Start in the background and watch one service
docker compose up -d
docker compose logs -f api

# Rebuild what changed and recreate only those containers
docker compose up -d --build

# Stop and remove containers and the network, named volumes stay
docker compose down

# Also remove volumes and locally built images
docker compose down -v --rmi local

# What Compose thinks the project looks like after merges and defaults
docker compose config

# Status and processes
docker compose ps
docker compose top

# Several copies of a stateless service
docker compose up -d --scale worker=3

sections.title: Compose Services
sections.description: Act on a single service instead of the whole project: exec, run, logs, restart and profiles.

snippets.code:
# Command inside the running container
docker compose exec api sh

# One-off container from the service definition, removed afterwards
docker compose run --rm api npm run migrate

# Only this service's output
docker compose logs -f --tail 100 db

# Restart, stop or remove one service
docker compose restart api
docker compose stop worker
docker compose rm -sf worker

# Rebuild just the API and recreate it
docker compose up -d --build api

# Start the services tagged with the debug profile
docker compose --profile debug up -d

# Merge a local override on top of the base file
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.override.yaml up -d

# Fetch images without starting anything
docker compose pull

sections.title: Registry
sections.description: Authenticate, push tags and inspect what a remote registry actually serves.

snippets.code:
# Log in, tag with the registry host, push, then forget the session
docker login ghcr.io -u felipe
docker tag cheatrs-api:1.4.0 ghcr.io/felipe/cheatrs-api:1.4.0
docker push ghcr.io/felipe/cheatrs-api:1.4.0
docker logout ghcr.io

# Token from stdin, so it never lands in shell history
echo "$GHCR_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io -u felipe --password-stdin

# Which registries already have stored credentials
jq '.auths | keys' ~/.docker/config.json

# Manifest and digest of a remote tag, before pulling it
docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/felipe/cheatrs-api:1.4.0
docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/felipe/cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Private registry on localhost for tests
docker run -d -p 5000:5000 --name registry registry:2
docker tag cheatrs-api:1.4.0 localhost:5000/cheatrs-api:1.4.0
docker push localhost:5000/cheatrs-api:1.4.0

sections.title: Cleanup
sections.description: Find what consumes disk and remove containers, images, volumes and cache that nothing uses.

snippets.code:
# Space used by each category, then per object
docker system df
docker system df -v

# Stop everything that is running
docker stop $(docker ps -q)

# Stopped containers and untagged images
docker container prune -f
docker image prune -f

# Every image not referenced by a container
docker image prune -a -f

# Unused networks and volumes
docker network prune -f
docker volume prune -f

# Build cache, keeping the most recent 2GB
docker builder prune -f --keep-storage 2GB

# Everything unused at once
docker system prune -a -f --volumes

sections.title: Healthchecks
sections.description: Let Docker test the process itself, then gate startup and deploys on the healthy state.

snippets.code:
# Probe defined by the image; start-period gives the app time to boot before failures count
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \
  CMD curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || exit 1

# Add or replace the probe for a single container
docker run -d --name cheatrs-api \
  --health-cmd "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health" \
  --health-interval 15s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 3 \
  cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Current state and the log of past probes
docker inspect cheatrs-api --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}'
docker inspect cheatrs-api --format '{{json .State.Health.Log}}'

# Block a script until the container reports healthy
until [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' cheatrs-api)" = "healthy" ]; do sleep 2; done

# Then it is safe to run migrations against it
docker exec cheatrs-api npm run migrate

sections.title: Security
sections.description: Shrink the attack surface: non-root user, read-only filesystem, dropped capabilities and scanning.

snippets.code:
# No root, no capabilities, no privilege escalation, read-only root filesystem
docker run -d --name cheatrs-api \
  --user 1000:1000 \
  --read-only \
  --tmpfs /tmp:size=64m \
  --cap-drop ALL \
  --security-opt no-new-privileges \
  -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 \
  cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Known vulnerabilities in the image layers
docker scout cves cheatrs-api:1.4.0
docker scout quickview cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Software bill of materials for auditing, as JSON by default
docker scout sbom cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Secrets from a file at runtime, never baked into the image or visible in docker inspect
printf 'hunter2' > db_password.txt
docker run -d --name cheatrs-db \
  --mount type=bind,source=./db_password.txt,target=/run/secrets/db_password,readonly \
  postgres:17

# The value is readable inside the container only at that path
docker exec cheatrs-db cat /run/secrets/db_password

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.description: Diagnose containers that exit immediately, restart in a loop or cannot reach each other.

snippets.code:
# Why did it stop? Exit code and the error recorded by the daemon
docker inspect cheatrs-api --format '{{.State.ExitCode}} {{.State.Error}}'

# Output from the run before the restart
docker logs --previous cheatrs-api

# Disk pressure is a common cause of failed pulls and builds
docker system df

# Bypass the entrypoint when the container dies before you can exec into it
docker run --rm -it --entrypoint sh cheatrs-api:1.4.0

# Does the app answer on the port the mapping expects?
docker exec cheatrs-api wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/health

# Can one container resolve the other by name?
docker run --rm --network cheatrs_net alpine:3.21 nslookup cheatrs-db

# Keep a file from a container that will be removed
docker cp cheatrs-api:/app/logs/error.log ./error.log

# What changed relative to the image
docker diff cheatrs-api

# Rebuild with fresh base images when the cache hides a change
docker build --no-cache --pull -t cheatrs-api:1.4.0 .
